summary: Make commerce administration a coherent task-first workspace and prevent stale async view contamination
evidence: Actual production admin orders/catalog/stock observed2026-10-25; no search/filter, long automatic first-product editor, blank async states. render passes the persistent content element to async renderCatalog, so a response after changing tabs can append the previous view into the new view.
